record.body:
## Rationale

The status tabs are unchanged. The stepper already looked like a phase picker, and users tried to use it as one; making it the selector removes that mismatch. The done count now opens the picker instead of expanding titles.

## Counter-argument

A display-only stepper cannot be misread as interactive state, and the selection could live on its own line instead.

payload.alternatives: keep the stepper as a display that expands finished titles; a compact mark rail for every phase
payload.choice: Status tabs show a word and a dim parenthetical tally with no leading digit. The stepper becomes the phase selector: a done count, the selected phase, in-progress phases, the next phase, and All phases
